briefdescription.para: Wave-B L7 thread-safety hardening — regression tests.

detaileddescription.para: Validates the 13 thread-safety sites fixed by the Wave-B L7 audit:

entry.para: Concurrent getModel() from 4 threads — no data race
setStateDb() concurrent with getPlugin() — no UAF
Plugin counter from 8 threads — atomic exact count

detaileddescription.para: All tests compile without ThreadSanitizer (TSAN detection is runtime-only). Run under TSAN to surface any residual data races.
